fields.value: Quantifying elemental colocation using energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy

dsDescriptionValue.value: This repository contains the data used for the related publication. The dataset contains images that can be analyzed with the relevant plugins to serve as benchmark for elemental colocation analysis.

publicationCitation.value: Quantifying elemental colocation in nanostructured materials using energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, Kristiaan H. Helfferich, Johannes D. Meeldijk, Marijn A. van Huis, Jessi E.S. van der Hoeven, Petra E. de Jongh, submitted.
